en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own wedding plan and get the same legal-versus-symbolic comparison and budget check
en.runTitle: Perth to Bali: a wedding for about 60 guests on AUD 45,000

fields.label: AUD ceiling
fields.value: AUD 45,000 for the wedding itself (venue, catering, decor, photographer, celebrant and legalities); guests pay their own travel

fields.label: Venue quotes and mandatory rooms
fields.placeholder: e.g. a villa quote that requires a three-night stay, or a resort package with included rooms

fields.label: Drinks and styling priorities
fields.placeholder: e.g. a free-flowing drinks package and lots of flowers

fields.label: Rain and accessibility needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. a covered seated layout for 60 and step-free access for an older relative

en.template: Compare a Perth legal marriage and symbolic Bali celebration for {guests} on {dates}, with {ceiling}, {venues}, {priorities} and {needs}. Show all-in costs, refundable security, payment/cancellation dates and unresolved items. Ask before contacting suppliers, sharing documents or making bookings.

phases.title: Read the official marriage and entry rules, and collect published venue and supplier prices
phases.note: The legal route, entry rules for guests, venue and catering prices
phases.judgment: It said plainly what it could not confirm: the Indonesian legal text for marrying as a foreigner could not be retrieved, so Australian Embassy guidance is not passed off as Indonesian law. The much-repeated Aksari package price of IDR 127,655,000 was left unverified, and the only agent price it found had expired on 31 December 2025.

phases.title: Build two fully worked budgets and the page, with every calculation shown
phases.note: A resort plan within the ceiling, a more comfortable villa plan, and a dated source list
phases.judgment: A separate colleague rebuilt all 19 budget rows from their inputs and found no discrepancies (the restrained plan: AUD 43,682.13, AUD 1,317.87 under the ceiling). It also asked for two phrases that sounded firmer than the sources, “funded rain structure” and “contracted 3 hours”, to be reworded as modelled allowances.

workers: Read the Australian and Indonesian official guidance on marrying in Bali, the Perth marriage process, and the visa and tourist-levy rules for guests
Found published prices for cliff-top venues in Uluwatu and venues in Ubud
Read the rate sheets and event rules of private villas that can seat 60 guests
Rebuilt every budget figure on its own from the inputs and checked the page’s claims against the sources

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你自己的婚礼计划，得到同样的法律婚与象征性庆典对比和预算核对
zh.runTitle: 从珀斯到巴厘岛：约 60 位宾客、预算 45,000 澳元的婚礼

fields.label: 澳元预算上限
fields.value: 婚礼本身 45,000 澳元（场地、餐饮、布置、摄影、证婚人和法律手续），宾客自付旅费

fields.label: 场地报价和强制订房
fields.placeholder: 例如：要求连住三晚的别墅报价，或含客房的度假村套餐

fields.label: 酒水和布置偏好
fields.placeholder: 例如：想要畅饮酒水套餐和大量鲜花

fields.label: 雨备和无障碍安排
fields.placeholder: 例如：60 人有顶的座位布局，并为年长亲戚提供无台阶通道

zh.template: 帮我们比较珀斯合法结婚和巴厘岛象征性庆典，日期 {dates}，人数 {guests}，预算 {ceiling}，已有 {venues}，偏好 {priorities}，需要 {needs}。列全价、可退保证金、付款取消日期和未确认项。联系供应商、分享文件或预订前先问我们。

phases.title: 查阅官方结婚与入境规定，收集场地和供应商的公开价格
phases.note: 法律途径、宾客入境规定、场地和餐饮价格
phases.judgment: 它明确说出了无法确认的部分：没能取得印尼关于外国人结婚的法律原文，所以不会把澳大利亚使馆的说明当作印尼法律。网上被反复引用的 Aksari 套餐价格 127,655,000 印尼盾也没有被当作事实，它找到的唯一一份代理报价已在 2025 年 12 月 31 日过期。

phases.title: 做出两份完整算过的预算和页面，每一步计算都写明
phases.note: 预算内的度假村方案、更宽裕的别墅方案，以及带日期的来源清单
phases.judgment: 另一位同事从原始数据重建了全部 19 行预算，没有发现任何出入（预算内方案总计 43,682.13 澳元，比上限低 1,317.87 澳元）。他还要求把两处比来源说得更肯定的措辞——“已列入预算的防雨搭建”和“约定的 3 小时”——改成模型假设的额度。

workers: 查阅澳大利亚和印尼官方关于在巴厘岛结婚的说明、珀斯的结婚流程，以及宾客的签证和旅游税规定
查找乌鲁瓦图悬崖场地和乌布场地公开发布的价格
查阅可容纳 60 位宾客的私人别墅的价目表和活动规定
根据原始数据独立重算每一项预算数字，并对照来源核对页面中的说法
